reuse.why: Routes every ranged-amount site through the existing exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts instead of editing the inline midpoint copies.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint computations (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) and leaves a single worst-case helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the other schedule amount/date helpers, and server modules import it as they already do for getNextDate.

scope.why: Only the amount sites, the helper, its tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A future change to how ranged amounts are planned is now a one-line change in getWorstCaseAmount, documented with its reason.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site keeps its own computation; all call getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount / getWorstCaseAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.
